sources.name: McGill International Student Services (ISS)
sources.notes: The single best-fit source for this city's mission but the domain sits behind Akamai bot protection - every request (curl with browser UA, and WebFetch) returned 403 as of 2026-08-26. No feed/API found, so this is registered manual (not probe) specifically so its one hand-entered event survives the build - a probe-kind source's manual_events are silently skipped by the builder's collect() loop before parse_manual ever runs. Its highest-value recurring event (International Student Welcome Reception, Aug 31) is hand-entered below. Re-probe with a real browser session if this needs to become a live feed.

sources.name: Concordia International Students Office (ISO)
sources.notes: AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) site; the events list renders client-side with no static feed or JSON endpoint found (only /content/concordia/manifest.json, a PWA manifest, matched .json). Dated workshops (Working in Canada, immigration obligations, Blue Cross info session) were readable in a search snippet and hand-entered below; re-check the live page each rebuild since AEM gives no feed to poll automatically.

sources.name: Université de Montréal Calendar
sources.notes: TYPO3 CMS, server-rendered facet-filtered activity list (has a 'publics-etudiants-internationaux'-style facet for international students) but no JSONAPI, RSS, or .ics export found on a first pass 2026-08-26 - the rss icon in the markup is decorative, not a real feed link. Worth a manual scrape parser later; registered probe for now, not one of the reusable kinds.

sources.name: YES Montreal (Youth Employment Services)
sources.notes: Free employment workshops for English-speaking Montrealers (career counselling, entrepreneurship, workplace French) - strong practical fit. Was Cloudflare-403 in Aug 2026; re-checked 2026-09-10 and the wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events feed now returns fine with the pipeline's normal headers (Cloudflare challenge relaxed) - 123 total events. WordPress + The Events Calendar.

sources.name: Bibliothèques de Montréal - Calendrier
sources.notes: Unlike Hamilton/Kingston, Montreal's public library network does NOT run Communico. The events calendar host (calendrier.bibliomontreal.com, indexed by search engines with library-specific event pages) is now DNS NXDOMAIN - confirmed dead via direct lookup and Google DoH on 2026-08-26, so the whole borough-by-borough library programming stream is currently unreachable. montreal.ca/calendrier is a Drupal-backed site but exposes no /jsonapi route (404) - checked as a fallback aggregator, also a dead end. Needs a fresh search for wherever the library calendar migrated to.

sources.name: Bureau d'intégration des nouveaux arrivants à Montréal (BINAM)
sources.notes: City of Montreal's own newcomer-integration office - mobilizes settlement/employment resources for new arrivals. Informational/coordinating body, not an events publisher; no dated public events found (content gap, not access gap, same pattern as Hamilton's HIPC / Kingston's Immigration Partnership). Left with an empty manual event list.

sources.name: Quartier des Spectacles
sources.notes: Montreal's downtown festival/entertainment district - the natural social anchor, but the site is an Astro app behind a 'Vercel Security Checkpoint' bot gate; every probe (?format=json, wp-json/tribe) returned 429 with the checkpoint HTML, not real data, 2026-08-26. Big free festivals it hosts (Jazz Fest, Nuits d'Afrique, Fierté, First Peoples' Festival, MUTEK) mostly land in Jun-Aug and are already past the build window each fall rebuild - re-probe closer to next summer.

sources.name: Ville de Montréal - Événements
sources.notes: City events listing; page is Drupal-backed (TYPO3-style asset paths) but /jsonapi, /jsonapi/node/evenement and /jsonapi/node/event all 404 - no exposed content API found 2026-08-26. Fall festivals sourced from Tourisme Montréal press coverage instead and hand-entered on the mtl-festivals manual source below.

sources.name: Tourisme Montréal - Fall Festivals
sources.notes: No feed - Tourisme Montréal's own site is a marketing page, not an events API. Used to source the two big festivals that land inside the fall build window (Festival du nouveau cinéma, RIDM); hand-entered below. Re-check dates/hours before drafting since only announcement-level info was available.

sources.name: Peoples Church of Montreal
sources.notes: Sunday service 10:30am at 2097 Union Ave (downtown, blocks from McGill campus, H3A). Runs CU20 - a dedicated College/University/20s connection group - the clearest student-relevant ministry found in this city. Wix site (format=json probe just returns HTML, no real feed). No forward-dated CU20 events published as of 2026-08-26; left with an empty manual event list per the no-recurring-events rule.

sources.name: Church 21
sources.notes: Multi-site Montreal-area church family with a dedicated University congregation location alongside Downtown/West Island/South Shore/Verdun/Vaudreuil/Centre-ville sites. Site platform is a small custom/1&1-hosted builder, no sqs or tribe feed (events?format=json 404s). Prayer/worship nights found during probing were already in the past by build time; left with an empty manual event list - re-check for a fall schedule.
